/bin/bash -lc "python3 - <<'PY'
import hashlib
import json
import os
import stat
from pathlib import Path

root = Path.cwd().resolve()
plan = json.loads((root / '.tools/edit-plan.json').read_bytes())
assert plan['version'] == 1
prepared = []
seen = set()
for entry in plan['files']:
    path = (root / entry['path']).resolve()
    assert path.is_relative_to(root)
    assert path.name not in {'user-work.txt', 'body.md'}
    assert path not in seen
    seen.add(path)
    before = path.read_bytes()
    assert hashlib.sha256(before).hexdigest() == entry['sha256'], 'Preimage SHA mismatch'
    mode = stat.S_IMODE(path.stat().st_mode)
    after = entry['content'].encode('utf-8')
    prepared.append((path, before, after, mode))

assert len(prepared) == 1
path, before, expected, mode = prepared[0]
before_lines = before.decode('utf-8').splitlines()
matches = [
    (number, line)
    for number, line in enumerate(expected.decode('utf-8').splitlines(), 1)
    if 'target final edit' in line
    and (number > len(before_lines) or before_lines[number - 1] "'!= line)
]
assert len(matches) == 1
with path.open('"'wb') as handle:
    assert handle.write(expected) == len(expected)
    handle.flush()
    os.fsync(handle.fileno())
if stat.S_IMODE(path.stat().st_mode) "'!= mode:
    os.chmod(path, mode)
actual = path.read_bytes()
verified = actual == expected
mode_preserved = stat.S_IMODE(path.stat().st_mode) == mode
assert verified and mode_preserved
number, diagnosis = matches[0]
assert actual.decode('"'utf-8').splitlines()[number - 1] == diagnosis
print(json.dumps({
    'applied': len(prepared),
    'verified': verified,
    'after_sha256': hashlib.sha256(actual).hexdigest(),
    'diagnosis': diagnosis,
    'diagnosis_line': number,
    'mode_preserved': mode_preserved,
}))
PY"
